Advanced polymers
for defense.

Defense applications require lighter, stronger materials for protection and performance in extreme conditions. Synboli develops tailored solutions for these requirements.

Discuss this application

Polymers in
defense.

Defense applications demand lightweight, durable materials for demanding operating environments. Synboli’s stated areas include structural components, individual protection and electromagnetic management.

PEEK, PC, polyesters and PA support lightweight, durable structures. PA, PU and PC improve individual protective equipment. Polyimide, silicone and PEEK support electronic shielding. Longer-lasting polyesters and PVDF can lower replacement frequency and lifecycle costs.
